List resource versions registered in the ariadne database

Source: R/utils.R
listResourceVersions.Rd

listResourceVersions shows the available versions for the different resources registered in the ariadne database. Any of those versions can be passed to ariadne. Resources labelled with "latest" cannot be versioned as they are dynamically accessed via their API or SPARQL endpoint.

listResourceVersions(default = FALSE)

Arguments

default

Logical scalar. Should only default versions be listed. (Default: FALSE)

Value

A data.frame with information on registered resource versions.

See also

ariadne

Examples

# View all available resource versions
listResourceVersions()
#>      resource      version
